buildCommand: npm ci && npx prisma generate && npm run build
startCommand: npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && node dist/server.js

JWT_SECRET.description: 32+ character secret. Set via Cyclic dashboard or here.

CLIENT_BASE_URL.description: Your Vercel frontend URL, e.g. https://vojas-frontend.vercel.app

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Use Neon free tier: postgresql://user:pass@host/db
